Administrators select supported storage mechanisms; unmarked workbook recommendations do not authorize additional tracking requirements.

Net change: Use one contribution category per partner and at most one sourcing partner per opportunity.
Requirement statement: Use one contribution category per partner and at most one sourcing partner per opportunity.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: October 21 consolidated review
Acceptance criteria: Record exactly one contribution category per partner–opportunity association: Sourced, Influenced or Fulfilled. A partner cannot receive multiple contribution labels on the same opportunity. At most one partner may receive Sourced credit on an opportunity; no sourcing partner is required when none sourced it. Do not split source credit. Keep multiple participating partners and their operational roles reportable independently of contribution category and the Transacting Partner bill-to field. Retain the existing opportunity-level Partner-only, Partner-Led, Joint and Sales-only classifications and their current rules for the remainder of 2026. Any later deprecation requires a separate decision; do not introduce new per-partner timing classifications. Preserve evidence-based source protection, booked-credit freeze and audited corrections. Changing the transacting partner or registering a deal does not automatically assign sourcing credit.

Net change: Reset review status and notify OM on resubmission from Stage 5 to Stage 6.
Requirement statement: Reset review status and notify OM on resubmission from Stage 5 to Stage 6.
Business rationale/Problem Statement: October 21 consolidated review
Acceptance criteria: OM may reject an opportunity from Stage 6 — Won Decision back to Stage 5 — Procurement. Require Order Review Status = Rejected, a rejection sub-status and explanatory notes. For every rejection, send email and Salesforce notifications to the opportunity owner and Sales Ops, including the opportunity name/link, Account, reason, notes, OM reviewer, rejection timestamp and Close Date. Retain the rejection history. On resubmission 5 → 6, revalidate the complete package and reset Order Review Status to New Order with no sub-status. Notify the OM group and assigned reviewer by email and Salesforce notification with the opportunity link, previous rejection reason/notes, submitter and resubmission timestamp. Deduplicate retries of the same event without suppressing later rejection/resubmission cycles.
